body.message:
The apartment is a 1-bedroom in Al Safa, available from May 1 at AED 6,999/month, all-inclusive, water, electricity, internet, and VAT all covered.

Al Safa is a calm, well-connected neighbourhood just off Sheikh Zayed Road, close to City Walk, Jumeirah Beach, and Downtown Dubai. Good mix of local feel and easy access to everywhere.

Here's the full listing with photos, floor plan, and location: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-al-safa-al-safa-1-13851850.html

How long are you planning to stay, Eman?
